Fires on the **first** sub-word fragment of a rare, multi-token word (utens|il, hippoc|ampus, pracov|ních, DPR, Tillerson), and is strongly suppressed on the **final** continuation piece of such words (…zzarella, …rgyz, …melon, …thane) — i.e. it tracks word-initial vs. word-completing subword position rather than any semantic content.

L0·N11698unmasked layer
This neuron is a ":" (colon) token detector whose sign depends on position: it fires strongly on colons occurring at the very start of a document (after a verse number, timestamp, headline, or heading word like "WHAT"), and is suppressed on colons appearing mid-document after field labels ("Hardware ID:", "Size:", "Duration:", "ISBN:").
